snippets.code:
learned = sai.learn.create([turn])
sai.control.open(machine: pc) do |lease|
  inputs = { "newsSite" => "TechCrunch", "topic" => "Fintech", "fileName" => "techcrunch_fintech.txt" }
  r = lease.run(learned, inputs)
  unless r.ok?
    learned = sai.learn.create(
      initial_code: learned.code,
      evaluations: [Sai::Evaluation.new(inputs: inputs, result: r, passed: false)]
    )
  end
end

snippets.code:
result = session.run("Clean up the temp folder") do |approval|
  if approval.link_only?
    puts "Approve in a browser: #{approval.url}"
    next nil # a person answers it; keep waiting
  end
  next ["yes", approval.questions.map { |q| [q["options"][0]["value"]] }] if approval.type == "choice"

  "yes"
end

snippets.title: Run, judge and repair on a computer
snippets.context:
require "sai"

sai = Sai::Client.new
pc = sai.machines.list.first

session = sai.sessions.create(machine: pc)
result = session.run("Open Notepad, type hello, save it to the desktop as hello.txt")

puts result.status # idle, needs_approval or error
puts result.text   # Sai's answer
p result.usage     # tokens and cost of this task
snippets.code:
job = sai.learn.create(
  task_template: "Open {{newsSite}}, find all {{topic}} news published today, write their headlines into Notepad, one per line, and save the file as {{fileName}}",
  inputs: { "newsSite" => "TechCrunch", "topic" => "AI", "fileName" => "techcrunch_headlines.txt" },
  machine: pc,
  criteria: "techcrunch_headlines.txt is saved and holds, one per line, the headlines of the AI articles TechCrunch published today",
  max_iterations: 3,         # up to 3 code versions; 0 (the default) only writes the code
  rollouts: 3,               # each version must pass 3 runs in a row
  reset: { code: <<~JS },
    for (const t of await machine.browser.listTabs()) await machine.browser.closeTab(t.tabId)
    for (const w of await machine.getWindow("Notepad")) await w.close()
  JS
  continue_with_agent: true  # after a failed run, the agent finishes the task and the repair learns from it
)
done = sai.learn.wait(job)   # can take an hour; timeout: to stop waiting
p done.status, done.stop_reason, done.test_result
puts done.code               # the latest version
done.iterations.each do |it|
  p [it.index, it.changes, it.rollouts.map(&:verdict)]
end

run = sai.learn.rollout(job, 1, 1) # what one run returned and logged, and its judgement
sai.learn.cancel(job)              # stops at once and keeps the last complete results
